name: action_control
description: Lets a player steer an entity with two actions, one per axis: move_x and move_y unless the entity names others (a second player on the same screen, a cursor and a character steered apart).

components.name: Controlled
components.description: The entity's Velocity follows the actions action_x and action_y (move_x and move_y when they are none), multiplied by speed. horizontal and vertical turn an axis off: the entity then leaves that part of its Velocity alone (a jumper steered left and right keeps vertical false, so gravity decides how it moves up and down).

systems.name: steer
systems.description: Sets the Velocity of every Controlled entity from the current value of its two actions.
